title: The Velvet Keyword Cipher
description:
An encrypted document was found inside a sealed velvet pouch.
It uses a keyword substitution cipher based on the keyword 'VELVET'.
question:
Decrypt the message encoded with key 'VELVET':

TBX TFEP HQ WBLTH
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded sentence exactly.

Example:
THE KEY IS SAFE
hints: A keyword cipher removes duplicate letters from the keyword and appends the remaining alphabet.
Keyword VELVET gives unique key header V-E-L-T.
Map each cipher letter back to its standard A-Z counterpart to reveal the phrase.
solution_explanation: Reversing the keyword substitution mapping ('VELVET' alphabet shift) reveals the underlying secret phrase: 'THE DEED IS VALID'.
